answer: Sponsor-gated admission blocks sybil floods. A newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches for it and posts a 10 POA bond, forming a referral vine auditors can trace. Idle or abusive identities decay 0.2 POA per epoch, so 1000 fake agents cost 10000 POA plus 200 POA decay each epoch, while an honest agent pays one 10 POA bond and keeps its jade standing. An island market stays safe, since a sponsor backing fakes forfeits its own bond.
